name: Das Walchsee Aktivresort
beschreibung:
Situated in the charming village of Walchsee in the Tyrolean Kaiserwinkl, Das Walchsee Aktivresort combines dynamic outdoor sports with holistic relaxation. Guests enjoy stylish rooms, an extensive spa and pool landscape, and wholesome gourmet cuisine.

Nearby Lake Walchsee offers swimming and water sports, while the Kaiser mountains provide spectacular hiking, cycling, and cross-country skiing routes.
kurzbeschreibung: Das Walchsee Aktivresort in Kaiserwinkl provides modern wellness, fine dining, and versatile active holidays between lake and mountains.
